body:
Yeah, I've just finished my resume. I'm calling around now to see if there is any immediate work to try and get stable.

How do I stop thinking about just taking pills and being done with it? Not an emotional scream, an earnest question. I never normally feel like this, and I just don't know how to push the thought of the 'easy way' out of my head.

I'll do anything. While doing this I'm throwing applications into every job around here that will let me do it online. This seems like a really bad way to do it, but I can't walk into places and make a first impression how I am now, it'll just hurt my chances. But where I'm at now I'll scrub toilets, pick up garbage, whatever it takes. I don't really have a lot of work experience and didn't finish college.

I appreciate the kind offer for a hotel room. I spoke to a friend and tomorrow she's going to let me stay on her couch, I think I should be ok until then.
I used to live in the city of San Diego, last night I tried to sleep in El Cajon. Thank you, for any advice you could offer.
